annotations.title: Read selected state nomination policy sections

description: Read selected policy blocks for one state; sections is required and nonempty. Start with the fewest blocks directly relevant to the question (fees for costs; application and policyNotes for state deadlines). programRules returns one upstream compiled project record, not all applicable conditions. It requires visaSubclass and exact program together; omit both for state-wide sections. In mixed requests they scope programRules only. For programRules, reuse the exact state/visaSubclass/program identity previously returned by this MCP in the current conversation. Otherwise first call get_state_nomination_occupations without program. User-provided pathway names, abbreviations or translations are not verified API identities. State-wide sections such as fees do not require directory discovery. Identify specific missing facts before reading more; if no block resolves a conflict, report it. available means data was read, not verified, undisputed or personal eligibility. federalRequirements is shared validity/deadline information, not all federal visa rules. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

locale.description: Language of names/descriptions in the result: zh-CN (default, Simplified Chinese plus English names), en-US, zh-TW. Also selects the language prefix of returned oneuedu.com URLs.

program.description: Required together with visaSubclass only when sections contains programRules. Omit both for state-wide policy sections. In mixed requests they scope programRules only; they do not filter other sections. Reuse the exact state/visaSubclass/program identity previously returned by this MCP in the current conversation. Otherwise first call get_state_nomination_occupations without program. User-provided pathway names, abbreviations or translations are not verified API identities.

visaSubclass.description: Required together with program only when sections contains programRules. Omit both for state-wide policy sections. In mixed requests they scope programRules only; they do not filter other sections.
